Cristiano Ronaldo hints at retirement, suggests final season is near

Football star Cristiano Ronaldo has indicated that his current playing career may be nearing its end. He stated that the upcoming year or the 2026-27 season could be his last. Ronaldo, who is contracted with Al Nassr until June 2027, expressed a desire to leave a "spectacular legacy." He has also begun considering his life after football, including spending more time with his family. Some reports also mentioned his return to Al Nassr training.
